verdict.rationale: The evidence shows mise keeps multiple tool versions on one machine and lets each project declare which one it uses. It never describes a content-addressable store, hash-keyed deduplication, or any guarantee that a dependency version is stored only once on disk across projects. Machine-level tool installs are an adjacent behavior, not the content-addressable shared store the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a shared content-addressable store so the same dependency version is stored once on disk across all projects
